'''Imperial Edict 273''' was an edict issued by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] declaring the Imperial-aligned [[House of Thul]] to be [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] rightful rulers. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], this edict was used as justification for Imperial allies and forces to prevent [[House Ulgo]] from reactivating [[Castle Panteer]]'s shield generator.
